# bezgoFresh

> Fresh fish and meat delivered straight from trusted local butchers to your doorstep in Palakkad, Kerala. Ordering is done through WhatsApp — no app, no sign-up.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.bezgofresh.com/): Fresh fish and meat delivery service — from butchers directly to your doorstep in Palakkad.
- [About Us](https://www.bezgofresh.com/know-more): The story of bezgoFresh, fresh selections, convenient WhatsApp ordering and swift delivery.
- [Contact Us](https://www.bezgofresh.com/call-to-reach): Order on WhatsApp, email us, or visit our head office near Town Square Club, Palakkad.
- [Team](https://www.bezgofresh.com/team): Meet the bezgoFresh team — founders, engineers and operations.
- [Refer & Earn](https://www.bezgofresh.com/refer): Refer friends and earn rewards on bezgoFresh.
- [Delivery Partner](https://www.bezgofresh.com/delivery-partner): Flexible work hours, weekly payouts — deliver with bezgoFresh in your own locality.
- [Partner with us (Butcher)](https://www.bezgofresh.com/butcher): More customers, more sales — partner with bezgoFresh as a butcher.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.bezgofresh.com/tc): Terms, conditions and FAQ for bezgoFresh.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bezgofresh.com/privacy-policy): How bezgoFresh collects, uses and protects your information.

## How ordering works

1. Click the order button — it opens a WhatsApp chat.
2. Select the items you need from your favourite butcher and add them to the cart.
3. Share your location via WhatsApp — your fresh order is delivered to your doorstep.
